headline_hook: Claude Ships Interactive Charts While Sora 2 Powers a Real Video API
preview_topics: the MoE model dropping on HuggingFace

pick_of_the_day.thesis: Karpathy's lost research agents reveal that we've already crossed the dependency threshold — when frontier AI stutters, real work stops, and nobody has a failover plan yet.

model_literacy.concept: Mixture of Experts (MoE) — Active vs Total Parameters
model_literacy.relevance: NVIDIA's Nemotron 3 Super claims 120B parameters but only activates 12B per token. Understanding MoE explains why a '120B model' can run on hardware that chokes on dense 70B models — and why the parameter count on the tin is increasingly misleading.

items.title: NVIDIA Drops Nemotron 3 Super: 120B Parameters, Only 12B Active
